theme_central: Sky and earth obeying their Lord as they should — an image of man, who likewise toils toward his Lord and will end up meeting Him, book in his right hand or behind his back.

branches.title: Sky split, earth spread out
branches.resume: Sky and earth fully obeying their Lord, emptying themselves of what they contain.

children.t: Sky split, earth spread out, total obedience to their Lord

branches.title: The book in the right hand or behind the back
branches.resume: Man toils toward his Lord and will meet Him; easy judgment or blazing fire depending on the hand receiving the book.

children.t: Book received in the right hand (easy judgment) or behind the back (blazing fire)

branches.title: Oath, gradual transformation
branches.resume: Oath by twilight and the night: you will certainly pass from state to state.

children.t: Oath by twilight; man passes from state to state

branches.title: Refusal to prostrate, closing
branches.resume: Why do they not believe, why do they not prostrate? Uninterrupted reward for the believing doers of good.

children.t: Refusal to prostrate condemned, uninterrupted reward promised to the believers
